name: P-013 workload D (4-tool recipe: 1 idempotent write, 2 reads, 1 declared wait): foreground orchestrate:run (control) vs durable DBOS orchestrate:run (candidate), D-016 matrix, 5 process-isolated repetitions
command: for k in 0..4: P013_DEDICATED_PG=native P013_MATRIX=1 P013_MODES=warm,cold P013_CONCURRENCIES=1,8 P013_WARMUPS=20 P013_WARM_SAMPLES=200 P013_COLD_SAMPLES=50 P013_REPETITIONS=1 P013_REPETITION_OFFSET=$k PAPERCUSP_TEST_FILE_TIMEOUT_MS=3600000 npm run test:file -- packages/operator-core/lib/blueprint/operation-performance-d.integration.test.ts (capability:bash task 0muk8ljkb1jyya4h1uj)
rig: Dedicated native PostgreSQL 18 cluster per repetition (libs/test-config/src/dedicated-native-pg.ts; Docker create was wedged, WI-10003403). Candidate cold children use a private DBOS system schema per run; production DBOS scheduled workflows suppressed in the benchmark executor; PAPERCUSP_MEMORY_EMBEDDER=disabled plus deterministic embedder on both arms (D-022(a)). Declared wait satisfied by the same fixture signal on both arms.

diagnosis.observation: Candidate totals quantize at ~1000ms (warm p50 1010ms at c=1 and 1012ms at c=8) and ~2000ms (warm p95 c=1 2008ms, cold p95 ~2080ms), independent of concurrency; the time sits in acceptedToDispatch (workflow enqueued -> first tool step started) and dispatchToTerminal. Control totals are 71-300ms.
diagnosis.hypothesis: [inferred, unprobed] the durable arm is dominated by DBOS queue dequeue polling (1s default pollingIntervalMs on the durable-orchestration queue) rather than per-step persistence cost: 4 durable steps and ~5KB of DBOS system-table bytes per run cannot account for ~1s. Probe: rerun one warm c=1 rep with the queue polling interval lowered (or direct DBOS.startWorkflow without a queue) and check whether totals drop by ~1s multiples.

notProven: dbRoundTrips is null (UNKNOWN, not zero) for both arms; control dbBytes/durableSteps are null because the foreground arm has no DBOS persistence to measure.
Candidate dbBytes is the DBOS system-table byte delta per trial as recorded by the rig; row-count deltas are represented by durableSteps (operation_outputs rows).
The bounded actual-provider smoke (kept separate from fixture latency by D-016).
The exactly-once idempotent write invariant is asserted inside the test per sample (test passed on all 5 repetitions); it is not re-derived here.
